question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **one.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"one"** means a single unit or thing. (एक)

 
 
• **Example: **She has one apple in her hand.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that one of the most essential components of human contact and communication is language. 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct answer is **'one'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Three **(तीन): The number after two and before four.

 
 
• **Example:** There are three books on the table.
 
 
 
• **Four **(चार): The number after three and before five.
 
 
• **Example: **She has four siblings.
 
 
 
• **Two** (दो): The number after one and before three.
 
 
• **Example:** I have two dogs.
